Criterion: Verify that a dry-run condition with an aerial refueling pump does not create a potential ignition source. Standard: A dry-run condition with an aerial refueling pump does not create a potential ignition source during ground and flight operations. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis of design, inspection of installation, and laboratory/ground/flight test verify that a dry-run condition with an aerial refueling pump does not create a potential ignition source. References: JSSG-2009: 3.3.3, 4.3.3; F.3.4.6.1.7, F.4.4.6.1.7; G.3.4.7.23, G.4.4.7.23
